acceptanceCriteria: The go-interop CI compiler is explicitly compatible with the declared portable module floor and documented stable runtime qualification; automatic downloads remain disabled.
Actual portable tests, vet and cross-build checks pass with the selected compiler; the updated hosted job result is retained without skipped failures relabelled PASS.
Prior Go1.24.13 compatibility evidence and qualification limits remain visible; workflow change receives independent review, required CEM binding and coordinated integration before native completion.
body: Confirmed configuration incompatibility observed 2026-10-02 during CEM Linux repair closeout. Public main 1fda1b94984245d0cd0ac0a6d17cc72572ce6619 .github/workflows/ci.yml go-interop selects Go 1.23.12 and explicitly sets GOTOOLCHAIN=local, GOPROXY=off and GOWORK=off. Delivered CEM integration source 1a355ea551c2745d3fe9f229a36acc348cb205d8 interop/cem01-go/go.mod declares go 1.24.0, an accepted source floor change documented in docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md. Code/config evidence confirms selected compiler below mandatory module floor with automatic switching disabled; actual newly updated hosted job has NOT_RUN, no runtime failure fabricated. Expected: the CI compiler meets the accepted source floor and actual stable structural qualification tuple is retained. Actual: current job selects an incompatible compiler, so corrected lifecycle source alone cannot make updated PR CI pass. Original PR476 earlier pipeline failed before this skipped interop step. Keep this separate from V1-0668 repair budget and from historical Go1.24.13 compatibility cases, both of which now PASS on portable Darwin. Dedup exact 1.23.12 and interop CI agent-memory searches found no existing ticket. Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build163, Tasks build202 observed. No CI edit or claim begun. Retained private evidence CURRENT-MAIN-COMPATIBILITY-PLAN.json. Root coordinator must schedule genuine workflow/CEM admission; no CI enforcement weakening or compiler auto-download workaround.
title: Align portable interop CI toolchain with the accepted Go 1.24 source floor
